His wife also says that he has begun to doubt her fidelity and believes that even the marriage counselor is on her side. B. Obsessive-compulsive personality disorder

Two weeks later, the patient develops vomiting, mild crampy abdominal pain, and watery, nonbloody diarrhea. Which of the following is the most appropriate pharmacotherapy?
A. Bethanechol
B. Metoclopramide
C. Atropine
D. Oxybutynin
